introduction: A sewer cleanout provides direct access to a property's main sewer line, making drain cleaning, inspections and sewer repairs more efficient.

Understanding sewer cleanout installation, benefits and maintenance helps homeowners protect their plumbing systems.

sections.title: What Is A Sewer Cleanout?
sections.subtitle: Understanding sewer access points
content: A sewer cleanout is an access pipe connected to the main sewer line that allows plumbers to inspect, clean and service the drainage system.
Cleanouts provide a convenient entry point for sewer cameras, drain cleaning equipment and emergency plumbing tools.
Most residential sewer cleanouts are installed outside the property near the foundation or along the main sewer route.
sections.highlight: A properly installed sewer cleanout improves future maintenance access and can reduce repair complexity.

sections.subtitle: Benefits of having proper sewer access
